sources.entry: VoxtMini - Voice input on local models: transcribe, translate and rewrite by voice in any app, in English, Chinese and Japanese. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/hehehai/VoxtMini) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: VoxtMini
summary.one_liner: VoxtMini is a free, open-source Mac dictation tool that uses local models to transcribe speech and type it at the cursor in any app.
use_cases: dictating text into any Mac app
transcribing speech offline on a Mac
dictating steps as lists or long text as paragraphs
summary.what_it_does:
Tap Right Option to start and tap again to stop a recording. Words appear under the pill as they are recognised, and a language model then removes fillers and false starts and fixes punctuation before typing the text at the cursor. Saying "over", "完毕" or "以上" and pausing can also stop recording, if that setting is enabled (off by default). Esc cancels a recording and Control-Option-V pastes the last result again. A Structure option turns steps into lists and long text into paragraphs, and with clean-up off the raw transcription is typed as heard.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Runs local models by default; remote processing only if the user chooses it
Right Option push-to-tap activation that types at the cursor in any app
Supports English, Chinese and Japanese, with voice translation and rewriting
Optional spoken stop phrases such as 'over', 完毕 and 以上
caveats: Mac only; no other platforms are named on the page
Spoken stop phrases are off by default and must be enabled in settings
